errors.evidence: The x-axis does not have a logarithmic scale. The tick marks are at specific, non-logarithmically spaced intervals (e.g., 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8).
The x-axis range ends at 9e8 (which is 9 * 10^8), not 10^9.

This is stated for all five lines, but all lines have distinct markers: triangles for Vanilla, plus-like markers for SepLLM (n=64), crosses for SepLLM (n=128), diamonds for SepLLM (n=64, H), and circles for SepLLM (n=64, H/T).
For the orange line (SepLLM n=64), the value at 1e8 TFLOPs is approximately 100%, not 99.5%.
The orange line (SepLLM n=64) does not remain steady after 1e8 TFLOPs. It continues to rise, peaks above 100% at 4e8 TFLOPs, and then declines.
The blue line (SepLLM n=128) does not remain steady. It fluctuates between approximately 99.7% and 99.9% for the rest of the plot.
The green line (SepLLM n=64, H) starts at approximately 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs, which is clearly below 98%.
The green line (SepLLM n=64, H) does not remain steady. It continues to rise, peaks above 100% at 6e8 TFLOPs, and then declines.
For the red line (SepLLM n=64, H/T), the value at 3e8 TFLOPs is approximately 98.6%, not 99%. The line peaks later at 4e8 TFLOPs with a value of approximately 99.1%.
